items.title: “I DON’T BELONG Here” Carter Bryant on Devin Vassell’s BRUTAL NBA Welcome

items.body_excerpt: Carter Bryant opens up about the Spurs practices that completely changed his view of the NBA. He explains how Devin Vassell made shot after shot over him, Kelly Olynyk kept exposing him for two weeks. Watch the full interview: https://youtu.be/MEHDJ9V-lIk 🏀 Download the Fanatics…
